$comment: Cross-book accumulators, permitted by methodology.md section 12 as amended 19 September 2026. Every leg must be a selection some book actually took (cleared threshold, not declined) -- legs no longer need to share one book. Not charged against any single book's £200 bank -- tracked here separately, its own running total, not itself edge-gated (no combined-edge threshold exists).

entries.decision_reason: Every leg was a selection that had already independently cleared the 3pp threshold under its own book (3 conclusion-book legs, 7 Codex-solo legs). Owner's reasoning for permitting cross-book combination: each leg is already research-backed regardless of which book took it, so the book boundary didn't add anything the underlying research process hadn't already provided. Moved here from ledger/deviations.json once methodology.md section 12 was amended 19 September 2026 to allow this.
entries.result_note: Dead as soon as the Tottenham-Villa BTTS No leg lost (final: Tottenham 1-3 Villa, both teams scored). An accumulator needs every leg to win. The other 9 legs have not all played yet, but nothing they do can change this outcome. Official bookmaker settlement will lag until the last leg concludes; recorded as lost now since the result is already mathematically certain.
